messages:
ben_support: Escalating ProteaHealth onboarding to CS. Account PH-320, ARR ~$150k. Onboarding stuck at bulk ingest step, seeing 422 validation and 401 token refresh. Renewal outreach in ~14 days. Need CS to lead a quick bridge and comms plan.

ben_support: Quick logs: 2026-05-03T10:12:05Z ERROR validate field=patient.contact.phone code=422 reason="invalid_format"; 2026-05-03T10:12:08Z ERROR auth code=401 detail="expired_refresh_token". Saw a 2.5x concurrent upload spike.

ops-bot: [incident] P1 created INC-2026-310 for PH-320 1 assigned to customer-success. SLA: initial outreach 2 business hours.

cassie_csm: I'll take this. Plan: 1) 20m triage call asap, 2) temp QPS bump + canary token rotate during call if needed, 3) follow-up email + schema sample. @omar_se can you join for token rotate?

omar_se: Will join. Likely client-side phone formatting + refresh cadence. Short-term: can rotate client secret and push a 24h QPS bump. Approve and I will run the steps. Runbook link: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/onboarding-issues

bеn_support: (typo fixed) Attached logs to INC-2026-310 and enabled org debug: `enable_org_debug PH-320 --ttl=12h`. Calendar invite sent for 11:00 PT.

cassie_csm: Draft status to customer: "Hi Alex 1 we're on it. Scheduling a 20m troubleshooting call at 11:00 PT to walk payload validation and rotate tokens if needed. We'll apply a temporary throughput increase to help retries. - Cassie, CSM"

omar_se: Performed canary rotate on test workspace, validated ingest success. Applied temporary QPS bump: `set_org_qps PH-320 --qps=220 --duration=24h`.

cassie_csm: Post-call: customer retried failed batch and succeeded. Actions: 1) send schema sample + small validator snippet, 2) monitor for 48h, 3) escalate to Renewals if errors reappear. Marking INC-2026-310 as P1 and updating case notes.

ben_support: Notified sales for visibility on renewal. Standing by for follow-ups.

cassie_csm: Update: monitoring looks good so far (<2% error). Will close thread after 48h stable and attach postmortem to case.
